title: Han2024 – SSVEP fatigue dataset with two frequency paradigms
description: This dataset contains 64-channel EEG recordings from 24 healthy participants performing two SSVEP-based brain-computer interface tasks, one with a low-frequency paradigm (8.0-15.5 Hz) and one with a high-frequency paradigm (25.5-33.0 Hz). Each paradigm had 16 targets with joint frequency-phase modulation (JFPM). The recordings include training and fatigue phases, so the data can be used to study how fatigue affects SSVEP-BCI performance and to evaluate dynamic stopping strategies.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz from 64 channels with a Synamps2 amplifier (Neuroscan), referenced to Cz. Each participant completed a training phase (6 blocks per frequency condition) and a fatigue phase (24 blocks per condition). Each block had 16 trials of 2 s visual flicker stimulation in a 4x4 matrix layout. The data are epoched and distributed as per-subject files.
